questions.question: Dr. Chamssi must train young dentists in data protection. What is the first piece of advice he should give them?
options: Data protection is an administrative constraint
Data protection is a pillar of patient trust
questions.explanation: Dr. Chamssi explains: 'Data protection is a pillar of patient trust and professional ethics.' Dr. Tazi: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Tazi must create a training center in dental data protection. What is the main objective?

The quality of compliance and data security
